categories.name: Manufacturing & materials
categories.rule: Medical nanobots: primary category Biology & medicine; nanotech as a tag.

categories.name: Energy & environment
categories.rule: Preserve energy versus electricity, capacity versus generation.

categories.name: Economy & society
categories.rule: Track geography and population; separate causal claims from observed events.

categories.name: Media, education & culture
categories.rule: Do not confuse availability with dominant use.

categories.name: Security & warfare
categories.rule: Distinguish device existence from prevalence or displacement of personnel.

rubric: Store outcome at the original deadline AND outcome at the review date. The display badge is only a summary.
Full stated outcome achieved by its deadline (or already achieved ahead of a future deadline).
Outcome and scope must match. Early is a timing qualifier, not a separate success bucket.
Full stated outcome achieved, but only after the original deadline.
Keep the original deadline verdict. Do not change it to on-time correct.
A material part was achieved, but the full test was not met.
Record which component, threshold, geography or adoption level remains unmet.
The due prediction was not materially achieved.
Means the dated forecast failed, not that the event is impossible forever.
The deadline has not passed and the full claim has not yet been met.
Log partial progress separately; being behind expectations does not close the forecast.
Verified wording cannot be assessed under a defensible, fixed criterion.
Explain ambiguity, missing deadline, inapplicable condition or incompatible metrics. Never use just to hide a miss.
Attribution and/or outcome checks are incomplete.
A workflow state, not a forecast verdict. All 88 imported candidates start here.
Duplicate for scoring, misattribution, non-prediction or another documented exclusion.
Keep the row and reason. Do not delete inconvenient forecasts.
Timing qualifiers, not independent outcome buckets.
Use actual achievement minus deadline for drift. Unmet claims have overdue time, not invented achievement dates.
Separate qualifier for reasonable disagreement about interpretation or evidence.
Record strict and alternative readings and why they differ; do not silently relax the criterion.
